operation.source_intent: Grant or extend a bounded local subscription grace window from a platform-admin support intervention without fabricating provider or payment success

semantics.grant: non-GRACE subscriptions may move to GRACE only when the canonical Laravel subscription state machine permits the transition
semantics.extend: existing GRACE uses the later of current grace end or server time as the base, then adds the requested bounded day count
semantics.provider_binding: provider identifiers remain unchanged; the operation does not call or mutate a provider
semantics.server_time_precision: grace deadlines are normalized to persisted second precision before authoritative reread comparison

security.subscription_ownership: TenantSubscription global tenant scope rejects foreign direct IDs
security.csrf: web route stack retained for POST mutation
security.audit: immutable tenant-scoped BillingAudit records actor, reason, request context, prior state and authoritative grace end

coverage: exact canonical operation identity and route marker
platform-admin middleware plus guest and non-admin denial
bounded 1-90 day input and support reason validation
caller-owned tenant, actor, provider, payment and absolute grace fields rejected
grant and extend semantics use server-owned time and authoritative persisted state
idempotent replay with conflicting request protection
monotonic replay after a later extension cannot shorten grace
immutable tenant billing audit with actor and request context
provider binding remains unchanged and no provider mutation occurs
authoritative collection reread exposes the committed grace end
no billing transaction or payment-success inference
active-tenant frontend contract binding and browser idempotency header
